verdict.rationale: First-party SIP trunking docs say you can connect your own PBX or SIP-enabled phone system to ElevenLabs Agents and route calls to agents without changing existing phone infrastructure. That directly addresses avoiding lock-in to bundled telephony. Missing for 10: evidence of Twilio/Telnyx number import, configuration-level details (codecs, auth, inbound/outbound trunk setup, supported carriers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
